Scarlet Enclave is a level 60 raid unique to , situated at in the easternmost area of the . It is the first raid entirely unique to Season of Discovery, with previous new additions having been dungeons or instanced world bosses. The Corrupted Ashbringer (Season of Discovery) is obtainable within the raid. All players in the Scarlet Enclave will receive the Resilience of the Dawn buff.

The Scarlet Enclave sets are gear sets obtained from the . Though the set bonuses only go up to 6, there are 8 available pieces, allowing some freedom in which ones to use to get the bonus. They are sometimes referred to as Tier 3.5. They can be obtained from either Bryon Steelblade at New Avalon or Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at Light's Hope Chapel in the . All items can be purchased for either a token that drops in the , or a Crusader's Chalice and a crafted Scarlet Uniform item of the same slot and armor type.
The Scarlet Caravan is a caravan of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Plaguewood in the . It carried the , and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered was sent to investigate it.

, a scarabid in Zereth Mortis.]]__NOTOC__ Scarabids are protoform beetles found in Zereth Mortis. They can be synthesized in the Protoform Forge using :Scarabid Lattices. Some of the smaller scarabids of Zereth Mortis have metallic outer shells to protect themselves which makes them very resilient. The red coloring on the :Fierce Scarabid lets potential opponents know it is not to be trifled with. While the Emerald Scarabid's brightly colored shell makes it more interesting to potential mates. Unfortunately, this also makes them interesting to potential predators.

The Scarlet heir, referred to in title as the Last Menethil, is a nameless figure mentioned in Scarlet Brotherhood propaganda. According to the Brotherhood, he is the son of Princess Calia Menethil and an unnamed nobleman of the Arathi bloodline, whom the princess secretly married during the late years of King Terenas Menethil II's reign. The Brotherhood claims that the child was rescued by a citizen during the fall of Lordaeron, and was subsequently sheltered by the Brotherhood in an undisclosed secure location. They also claim that he is the last surviving member of the House of Menethil, the rightful heir to the kingdom of Lordaeron, and intend to reveal him as their "true king" (compared

This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Liberation of Undermine Raider. To begin, get to an intermission when Gallywix spawns adds. Normally, when the adds die, one player runs a bomb to a giga coil platform and all the rest get tossed in the center or off the edge of the arena. For this achievement, three players need to run bombs to platforms in the same phase. Only one platform initially opens, but after the first bomb gets used, the rest open.
